errors.USER_ALREADY_EXISTS_USE_ANOTHER_EMAIL: This email is already registered — just sign in.

errors.INVALID_TOKEN: This link is invalid or has already been used.
errors.INVALID_USER: The signed-in account doesn't match this link. Sign out first, then open it again.
errors.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS_REQUEST_NEW_CODE: Too many attempts. Request a new code.
errors.ACCOUNT_TEMPORARILY_LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. Your account is temporarily locked — try again later.

errors.invitation_email_mismatch: This invitation was sent to a different email than the account you're signed in with.

errors.seat_limit: This organization has no seats left. Ask the person who invited you.
errors.not_found: The invitation doesn't exist or is no longer valid.
errors.invalid_signature: This link is no longer valid. Go back to the desktop app and sign in again.

errors.SECURITY_CODE_TOO_LONG: The security code can be at most 32 characters.
errors.SECURITY_CODE_EQUALS_PASSWORD: The security code must be different from your password.

errors.insufficient_role: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.cannot_freeze_self: You can't freeze your own account.

login.title: Sign in to bianfa
login.desc: Sign in with your email and password.
login.desktopDesc: After signing in you'll be sent straight back to the desktop app.
login.totpDesc: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

signup.title: Create your bianfa account
signup.desc: Free account — your notes sync across devices. No email verification needed.
signup.desktopDesc: After signing up you'll be sent straight back to the desktop app. No email verification needed.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.desc: Enter the email you signed up with, the security code you chose at sign-up, and a new password. No email needed.
forgot.codeHint: You chose the security code when you signed up. If you can't remember it, set a new one from Settings → Account in a desktop app that's still signed in.
forgot.doneDetail: Every device has been signed out. Sign in with the new password — the desktop app will need to sign in again too.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.desc: Choose a new password. Other devices will be signed out.
reset.doneDetail: Sign in with the new password — the desktop app will need to sign in again too.
reset.invalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired.
reset.invalidDetail: Reset links last 30 minutes and can only be used once.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.doneDetail: You can go back to the desktop app and continue signing in, or manage your account here.
verify.expiredDetail: Links last 15 minutes. You can request a new one when signing in.
verify.invalidDetail: It may have been used already, or it's incomplete.
verify.changeDoneDetail: We've sent a verification email to the new address — the change takes effect once you open that link.

consent.title: Authorize access
consent.scopeOffline: Stay signed in while you're away (to sync notes)
consent.returningDetail: If the browser doesn't redirect, switch back to the desktop app.
consent.missing: This page has to be opened from the desktop sign-in flow.
consent.missingDetail: Go back to the desktop app and click Sign in once more.

device.title: Connect the desktop app
device.desc: Enter the 8-character code shown in the desktop app.
device.codeInvalid: The code is {{n}} letters or digits.
device.codeUnknown: We don't know that code — check it for typos.
device.reviewTitle: Allow this device to sign in?
device.reviewDesc: {{client}} is asking to sign in with your account.
device.reviewHint: Make sure the code in the desktop app matches this one before allowing.
device.approved: You can go back to the desktop app
device.approvedDetail: It will finish signing in within a few seconds. You can close this page.
device.deniedDetail: The desktop app will not sign in. If this wasn't you, consider changing your password.
device.expiredDetail: Go back to the desktop app and click Sign in again to get a new code.
device.taken: This code is already in use by another account
device.takenDetail: Go back to the desktop app and click Sign in again for a new code.

invite.title: Team invitation
invite.loginHint: Sign in or sign up with the invited email to accept.
invite.acceptedDetail: Team notes will show up in the desktop app.
invite.rejectedDetail: The person who invited you will see that you didn't join.
invite.invalid: This invitation is invalid or has expired
invite.invalidDetail: Invitations last 48 hours. Ask the sender to invite you again.

account.title: Account
account.desc: Sync, teams and devices are managed in the desktop app.
account.desktopHint: Manage devices and teams from Settings in the desktop app.
account.securityCodeHint: Your security code is only used to reset your password. Change it in the desktop app under Settings → Account.

notes.title: My notes
notes.encrypted: End-to-end encrypted — not viewable on the web
notes.empty: No notes in this workspace yet
notes.emptyHint: Notes you create in the desktop app show up here.
notes.noWorkspaceHint: Your personal workspace is normally created at sign-up. If this stays empty, sign out and sign in again.

sync.readonly: You can view this note but not edit it — changes won't be saved.

failure.forbidden: You don't have edit access to this note (or it was just revoked)
failure.unauthorized: Your session expired — please sign in again
failure.too_many_connections: Too many open connections for this account. Close a few tabs and retry.
failure.stalled: Several attempts failed, so we stopped retrying. Reload to try again.
failure.offline: Can't reach the sync service. Check your connection and try again.

admin.title: Platform admin
admin.desc: Only platform administrators can open this. Granting and revoking that role happens on the server — there is no switch for it here.
admin.auditNotice: Every view here is written to the audit log: who looked at whose content, and when. It can be traced afterwards.

gate.forbidden: You don't have access to this page
gate.forbiddenDetail: This page is for platform administrators only.
gate.forbiddenHint: The server refused you, not this page: the administrator list can only be changed from the command line on the server.
gate.disabled: The admin console is turned off
gate.disabledDetail: This deployment has the platform admin console disabled — none of its endpoints exist here.
gate.disabledHint: To turn it back on, change the server configuration and restart the api process.
gate.unauthorizedDetail: Sign in again, then reopen this page.

detail.noOrgs: Not a member of any organization.
detail.noTeams: Not a member of any team.

actionsPanel.reasonHint: Stored in the audit log, 200 characters max.
actionsPanel.freezeConsequence: Freezing immediately drops all of this user's sync connections and blocks sign-in: every device token already issued is revoked. You can unfreeze at any time.
actionsPanel.freezeDone: Account frozen. {{n}} device sign-ins were revoked.
actionsPanel.unfreezeConsequence: The account can sign in again, but every device has to sign in once more.
actionsPanel.passwordConsequence: This revokes all of the user's device tokens and sessions: every device drops out immediately and has to sign in with the new password. Pass the new password to them through a trusted channel.
actionsPanel.passwordDone: Password reset. {{n}} device sign-ins were revoked.

content.workspacesHint: These are the workspaces this user can see, including the team workspaces of teams they belong to.
content.noWorkspaces: This user can't see any workspace.
content.e2eeShort: The server only holds ciphertext — an administrator can't read this.
content.author: Author
content.e2eeDetail: It is end-to-end encrypted; the server stores ciphertext only.
content.e2eeHint: The key lives on the user's own devices. Administrators can't see it and shouldn't — this is not a blank note.

audit.title: Audit
audit.desc: Everything administrators have done, including whose content they looked at.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link may be incomplete, or the page has moved.
